threads.context: Question: How do I access campus WiFi in the library? Answer: Select 'Univ-Secure', use your full student email (user@univ.edu), and reset your password if locked out.

Question: Where do we submit course registration override forms for the CS department? Answer: Override forms must be submitted directly to Room 302 in the Engineering Building before 5 PM on Fridays.
Question: Where is the campus tech support desk located? Answer: The IT Help Desk is located on the 1st floor of the Student Union, right next to the bookstore. Open Monday–Friday, 8 AM to 6 PM.
